title: MASTER CLIENT SERVICE & HR CONSULTING AGREEMENT
subtitle: Confidential Service Level & Commercial Agreement
description: Standard B2B agreement for client onboarding, recruitment/HR services, deliverables, and milestone billing.

defaultSections.heading: 1. Scope of Services
defaultSections.body: The Service Provider agrees to deliver end-to-end HR consulting, talent acquisition, and client lifecycle management services as mutually agreed with {{client_company}} (represented by {{client_name}}).
bullets: Dedicated HR account management and regular progress reporting.
Candidate sourcing, screening, documentation verification, and onboarding coordination.
Compliance and documentation management tailored to client specifications.

defaultSections.heading: 2. Commercial Terms & Invoicing
defaultSections.body: Total agreed commercial value: {{currency}} {{deal_amount}}. Invoices will be issued via Zoho Books according to the agreed milestone schedule below and are payable within 15 calendar days of issuance.

defaultSections.heading: 3. Replacement & Quality Guarantee
defaultSections.body: Should any placed candidate or deliverable require replacement within the agreed guarantee period due to performance or voluntary exit, the Service Provider shall provide a qualified replacement at no additional sourcing fee.

defaultSections.heading: 4. Confidentiality & Data Protection
defaultSections.body: Both parties agree to maintain strict confidentiality regarding all proprietary business information, candidate profiles, compensation structures, and internal documentation shared during the engagement.
